name: brand_config_amazon_asin
description: Customer-editable per-ASIN configuration: the ontology variant and product family an ASIN belongs to, its display labels with optional per-country overrides, and a description.

name: brand_config_amazon_attributes
description: Customer-editable, Amazon-keyed scoped attributes — unit costs, VAT rates, unsellable-return loss, the brand-registry flag and inventory-planning inputs.

name: brand_config_amazon_family
description: Customer-editable product families, grouping related ASINs under an ontology category.

name: brand_config_business_attributes
description: Customer-editable workspace-level business attributes, such as business age, employee count and valuation multiple.

name: brand_config_ontology_category
description: Customer-editable ontology categories: one row per category, holding the authored property values in data and the inherited-and-resolved values in dataResolved.

name: brand_config_ontology_metadata
description: Declares the ontology properties available to category and variant configuration: one row per property, with its value type, allowed values and whether it applies to categories, variants or both.

name: brand_config_ontology_variant
description: Customer-editable ontology variants: one row per merchant SKU, assigned to a category, holding the authored property values in data and the inherited-and-resolved values in dataResolved.

name: brand_ontology_amazon_asin
description: Read view of the customer-editable per-ASIN configuration (brand_config_amazon_asin) with its ontology variant and product family resolved, one row per configured ASIN.

name: brand_ontology_amazon_family
description: Read view of the customer-editable Amazon product families (brand_config_amazon_family) joined to the ontology category each belongs to, one row per family.

name: brand_ontology_category
description: Read view of the customer-editable ontology categories (brand_config_ontology_category), one row per category.

name: brand_ontology_variant
description: Read view of the customer-editable ontology variants (brand_config_ontology_variant), one row per merchant SKU, with the category it is assigned to.

name: fx_ecb_rate_history
description: European Central Bank foreign-exchange reference rates, append-only: one row per (currency, frequency, period).

name: fx_ecb_rate_latest
description: The most recent European Central Bank foreign-exchange reference rate per (currency, frequency), a cache derived from fx_ecb_rate_history.

name: databrill_schema_version
description: Records which version of the published Databrill tenant schema contract this database satisfies, one row per component.
